content: Muse Bolla Dereza Denth
Derezi he gallassa omars kumeth ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi waassishe aqides;
Kumeththa Isra7eele maabaray Muse bollanne Aaroone bolla zuuzumishe, «Nuni kase heen Gibxen dishe woykko hayssa ha bazzo biittan hayqqidaakko nuus lo7okkoshin!
GODAY nuna hinno he dereyo aazas efizee? Nuni wurikka olan wuranaas doos; nu machchetinne nu naytikka di7ettana; hessafe nuni duge Gibxe simmiko nuus lo7ana» gida.
Hessa gishshas istti ba garsan issoy issaara, «Ane haa yiite! Nuna kaaleththana as dooridi ane aggi guye Gibxe simmoos» gi haasayettida.
He wode Museynne Aarooney kumeththa deraa sinththan biitta bolla gufannida.
Biittayo xomosanaas kiitettida asatappe Nawe naa Iyaasoynne Yoofine naa Kaalebey yo7ozan daro ceecidi bantta may7oza daakkida.
Istti derezas, «Nuni biidi yuuyi xomosi xeellida biittaya keeha lo7o biitta.
GODAY nunan ufayettidaa gidikko izi nuna hee efana; eessinne maaththi izin kumida gasa biittayo izi nuus immana.
Intte gidikko GODAA bolla makkallofte! Heen diza derezaska babofte! Nuni istta qiison xoonana; GODAY nunara dees; istta bollafe eeshoy dendichchida gishshas intte isttas mulekka babbofte!» gida.
Istta shuchchara caddi wodhanaas kumeththa maabaray istta bolla dendides; gido attiin GODAA bonchchoy Isra7eele asaa kumeththaas Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan qonccides.
Musey Derezas Woossida Woosa
GODAY Muses, «Hayssi derezi ayde gakkanaas tana kadhanee? Tani dereza sinththan daro malaata ooththadis; histtiin derezi tanan ammanettontta ayde gakkanaas ixxanee?
Hekko ha7i tani iita harge istta bolla ehada istta ubbaa wursana; nena gidikko isttafe aadhdhiza mino kawoteththas aawasana» gides.
Musey gidikko GODAAS, «Neni hayssa dereza ne wolqqan Gibxeppe kessadasa; neni hayssa ne dereza bolla ooththidayssa Gibxe asay siyida wode,

hessa hanida yo7o ubbaa hayssa derezan diza asaa kumeththas istti yootana; hayti ha asati neni GODAY nunara dizayssanne shaaray nuuppe bollara qonccen beettiza mala neni gallas gallas shaara mala tuussan omars omars tama mala tuussan gidada nuuppe sinththe aadhdha kaaleththizayssa siyishe gam7ida.
Histtiin ne ha7i ne asaa wursa wodhikko ne goobateththaa siyida kawoteth ubbay,
nena, ‹Izi ba dereza gelththana giidi kase caaqqida caaqoza polanaas dandayontta aggida gishshas istta bazzon wodhi dhayssides› gaana.

Godoo hayssafe kase neni, ‹GODAY elle hanqetti erenna; iza maaroteththaynne iza siiqoy daro; izi nagaranne geellateththaa atto gaana; gido attiin naytanne isttas nayta nayta gakkanaas istti yelidayta nagara gishshas ta istta qaxxayana› gida mala polada ne wolqqa bessa.
Ha7ikka Godoo! Laamettontta ne gita siiqozan istti Gibxeppe kezoosofe hanno gakkanaas ne istta maarida mala hayssa deraa nagara ne maarana mala ta nena woossays» gides.
GODAYKKA Muses, «Ne tana oychchida mala ta istta maaradis.
Gido attiin tani de7on diza malanne ta bonchchoy biitta ubbaan kumida mala,
tani isttas Gibxeninne hayssa bazzo biittan ooththida gita malaatanne ta bonchchoza be7idi taas azazettontta ixxidaytappenne tammuto tana paaccida asatappe oonikka,
tani kase istta aawatas immana gaada caaqqida biittayo istti mulekka gelettenna; tana kadhiday oonikka izo mulera be7enna.

Gido attiin ta oosanchcha Kaalebes hankkoytappe dumma qofay izas diza gishshassinne izi tana kumeththa wozinappe kaallida gishshas izi biidi kase yuuyi xeellida biittayo ta izas immana; iza zereththatikka he biittayo laattana.
Amaaleeqe dere asaynne Kanaane dere asay shoobba giddon diza gishshas intte wonto guye simmidi Zo7o abba baggara efiza ogezara gede bazzo simmi biite» gides.
Zuuzumidayta Qaxxayeteth
GODAY Musessinne Aaroones hizgides,
«Hayti iita asati ayde gakkanaas ta bolla zuuzumanee? Ha zuuzumettiza Isra7eele asay ta bolla zuuzumettishin ta siyadis.
Ne isttas, ‹Tani ta de7o sunththan caaqqays; tani intte haasayshin ta hayththan siyida mala intte bolla ooththana; tani GODAY hayssa yootadis.
Intte ta bolla zuuzumettida gishshas intte garsafe qoodettishin layththay nam7u tammunne izappe bollara gididayta ubbaa ahay hayssa bazzo biittan kundi attana.
Intte he dereyo gelidi de7ana mala kase ta inttes caaqqadis; gido attiin Yoofine naa Kaalebeppenne Nawe naa Iyaasoppe attiin inttefe issaadeyka he biittayo gelenna.
Di7ettidi attana geetettida intte nayta intte kadhida biittayo ta gelththana; he biittayo ta istta laatissana.
Intte ahay gidikko hayssa ha bazzozan kundi attana.
Intte nayti intte ammanontta ixxida gaason inttefe wurseththan hayqqizaade ahay bazzo biittan kundi attana gakkanaas 40 layth kumeth gita meto ekkishe hayssa ha bazzozan toylattana.

Intte he biittaa xomosi xeellida 40 gallassaa qoodan issi gallassayo issi layth, hessika oyddu tammu layth kumeth intte intte nagaraa gishshas waayettana; tani intte intte bolla dendidayssa intte hessan erana.
Ta bolla dendida iita asata bolla tani hayssa ubbaa ooththana; hayssa bazzozan ubbatikka wuri wurana; ubbatikka hayqqana; tani GODAY hayssa yootadis› ga yoota.»
Musey Kanaane biittayo xomosi xeellanaas kiitti yeddida asati biidi biittayo beyi simmidaappe guye he biittay gishshas iita wore ehidi derezi ba garsan zuuzumettana mala ooththida.
He asati GODAA sinththan boshan shocetti hayqqida.
He biittayo biidi xomosi xeellida asata giddofe Nawe naa Iyaasoynne Yoofine naa Kaalebey xalla shemppora paxa attida.
Kanaane Biitta Bolla Dendida Koyro Worajja
GODAY gidayssa Musey Isra7eele asaas yootiin asay camo yeeho yeekkides.

Wonteththa gallas wontta maaladora istti dendidi pude gezzetizaso kezanaas giigettidi, «Nuni nagara ooththoyssaka zaari akeekidos; ha7i gidikko nuni kase Xoossi nuna gelththana gi hidota immida dereyo baanaas giigettidos» gida.
Musey gidikko isttas, «Histtiin intte GODAAS ha7ikka ays azazeteketii? Intte qoppidayssi inttes suurenna.
Hessa gishshas intte hee boopite GODAY inttenara gidontta gishshas intte morkketi inttena xoonana.
Amaaleeqe asaynne Kanaane asay inttenara heen olettana; gido attiin intte GODAA aggida gishshassinne izi inttenara baynda gishshas intte he olaan hayqqana» gides.
Muse gidiin Caaqo Qaala Taabotazi kase ba diza heeraappe dendontta dishin istti pude gezze biittayo olanaas xalateththan dendida.
Hessafe guye he deren diza Amaaleeqe asaynne Kanaane asay istta bolla meto gaththidi xoonida Horma gakkanaas gooddi yeddida.
